name: skill-recorder
description: Record on-screen work and turn it into reusable AI-agent skills with a configurable model provider.
author: Skill Recorder contributors

scripts.dist: npm run assets:prepare && npm run compliance:prepare && node scripts/assert-generic-dist-platform.mjs && npm run build:vite && node scripts/run-macos-signed-builder.mjs --publish never --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:app:mac: npm run assets:prepare && npm run compliance:prepare && npm run build:vite && node scripts/run-macos-signed-builder.mjs --publish never --mac dir --arm64
scripts.dist:portable:mac: npm run assets:prepare && npm run compliance:prepare && npm run build:vite && node scripts/run-macos-signed-builder.mjs --publish never --mac zip --arm64

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Better Skill Recorder reads the active browser tab URL only while you are recording, so it can reconstruct the steps you performed.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Better Skill Recorder uses your microphone only while you turn on Narrate during a recording, to transcribe your spoken narration on this computer.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Better Skill Recorder uses the macOS screen-capture framework to record on-screen work. System audio is not recorded.
